cover.coreProposition: Capability qualification and recoverability qualification must be independent adoption gates: activation should bind an exact, independently verified recovery bundle for the frozen mutation rather than infer recoverability from forward improvement or the modifying worker’s own account.
cover.visualMetaphor: A bright forward arrow reaches a higher platform while a separate return key remains outside the gate
cover.semanticObject: One ascending capability path beside a distinct sealed return key
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a rising geometric path on the left and an independently framed recovery key on the right
